name: Powell down the Colorado
traveler: John Wesley Powell and nine men
summary: A one-armed Civil War veteran leads four boats down the Green and Colorado rivers through the last blank on the map of the United States, the canyons of the Colorado Plateau. Three men who leave the river near the end are killed; the rest emerge after 99 days.

stops.note: Four wooden boats and ten men launch.
The No Name is smashed; a third of the food is lost.

stops.place: Confluence of the Green and Grand
stops.note: Where the Green meets the Grand to form the Colorado.
'We are now ready to start on our way down the Great Unknown.'
Three men climb out rather than run the rapid; they are killed on the plateau.
The six who stayed on the river reach the settlements.

informs.note: The last blank: the Colorado canyons
